local_integration.title: Local integration
local_integration.notReady: Local integration is available after the run succeeds.
local_integration.externalBody: Integration is blocked to avoid repeating work. Orchester has no historical merge record for this result. Recording an external merge, squash or cherry-pick needs an accepted scoped mapping; automatic reconciliation is unsupported.
local_integration.fullAncestry: Observed source {{source}} is fully contained in destination {{target}}. No historical merge is recorded; repeated integration is blocked.
local_integration.partialAncestry: Destination {{target}} contains only part of source {{source}}. Complete or scoped integration is unproven; an accepted mapping is required.
local_integration.equivalentPatches: Destination {{target}} has equivalent patches from source {{source}}, without complete ancestry. Scoped integration is ambiguous and cannot be recorded automatically.
local_integration.equivalentTree: Source {{source}} and destination {{target}} have matching trees, without complete ancestry. Recording external integration requires an accepted scoped mapping.
local_integration.unknownSource: The relevant source scope {{source}} cannot be established for destination {{target}}. Integration is unavailable until its identity is reconciled.
local_integration.externalEvidence: Observed result {{source}} and destination {{target}} have external integration evidence. Complete ancestry, partial ancestry and equivalent patches are distinct; no historical merge is recorded. Review current evidence before continuing.
local_integration.reviewBody: Review exact staged and working-copy snapshots. Ignored files are excluded and retained; a collision pauses delivery.
local_integration.commitBody: Selected content and target HEAD are pinned to this review.
local_integration.preserveBody: Retained independently from the run worktree.
local_integration.name: Preservation name
local_integration.syncBody: Check runs against the committed synchronized result. Waiting for approval holds no queue slot.
local_integration.checked: Check passed on the exact merged result
local_integration.checkedBody: Review the resolved diff. Any checkout or result change invalidates this approval.
local_integration.approval: I reviewed this exact checked result.
local_integration.taskConflictBody: Resolve the base into the run worktree. Nothing from this task has reached the main checkout yet.
local_integration.candidateChoice: {{choice}} selected as a candidate. Save result to apply it.
local_integration.markers: Save first. Recheck file identity, markers and unmerged index entries before continuation.
local_integration.resolved: I reviewed the resolved task merge.
local_integration.restoreTitle: The task is merged. Local changes need restoration.
local_integration.restoreBody: The recorded merge stays merged. Restoration cannot repeat it. Originals remain recoverable until verification.
local_integration.restoreReviewed: I reviewed content and staged placement.
local_integration.restored: Local changes restored and placement verified
local_integration.completeBody: The actual merge and restoration are recorded. Local recovery cleanup is a separate person decision.
local_integration.removed: Retained content removed; journal metadata remains
local_integration.recoveryBody: Read actual HEAD, index, Git markers and retained outcomes before continuing. Unknown outcomes need your review.
local_integration.stopping: Stop requested · waiting for a safe boundary
local_integration.abortBody: Only the exact owned merge in the run worktree is aborted. Main checkout and named local recovery remain intact. Additional edits make abort unavailable.
local_integration.abortAgree: I understand the owned task merge will be aborted.
local_integration.cleanupBody: Restoration must still verify. This removes retained content only; merge and journal metadata remain. This action cannot be undone.
local_integration.cleanupAgree: I reviewed the verified restoration and removal scope.
local_integration.unsavedBody: Save or discard only the editor draft. Original versions and recovery stay intact.
local_integration.binary: Binary content · choose a version deliberately
local_integration.sensitiveDraft: Sensitive draft hidden. Clear or discard the draft before continuing; unavailable secret access also hides editing.
local_integration.sensitive: Sensitive preview is unavailable. Originals remain retained; choose a version without exposing content.
local_integration.cancelPreservation: Cancel integration and restore local changes
local_integration.cancelTitle: Restore preserved local changes before merge?
local_integration.cancelBody: Restore verified originals and staging to this unchanged base. The task is not merged; recovery stays retained until cleanup.
local_integration.cancelAgree: I reviewed the unchanged base and restoration scope.
local_integration.releaseBody: Release this operation's checkout reservation. Completed commits and all checkout content stay in place. The task is not merged; retained commit originals and journal metadata remain.
local_integration.releaseAgree: I reviewed the cancellation scope. Completed commits and checkout content will be retained.
local_integration.priorOperation: Run #{{run}} still reserves this checkout. Cancel or recover its local integration before continuing the latest run.

error.draftStale: The saved candidate belongs to an earlier file/source identity. It remains retained; it cannot resolve a different file or newer checkout.
error.metadata: Sensitive checkout metadata cannot be displayed. File names, branches, paths and original content remain unchanged.
error.stale: Checkout or result changed after review. No stale approval can authorize it.
error.foreign: Another Git operation or client owns this checkout. Orchester cannot abort or take ownership of it.
error.unchecked: Run a real fresh Check before requesting approval.
error.authority: This action's initiating authorization is no longer available. Review the current state.
error.approval: A person must approve this exact checked result.
error.unverified: Recovery content has not been verified; it remains retained.
error.unknown: The outcome is uncertain. Reconcile actual Git state before choosing a safe continuation.
error.conditionalRemoval: Conditional file removal cannot be performed safely on this platform. Originals remain retained and no replacement is deleted.
error.unsupported: This path, file type or repository format is unsupported. Review the recorded operation and retained recovery before continuing.
error.collision: The reviewed destination already exists. Choose a non-colliding path.
error.unresolved: Resolve all files and conflict markers before continuing.
error.blank: Enter a message or preservation name.
error.git: Git or a hook refused the operation. Review current checkout identities before retrying.
error.io: The checkout could not be read or written. Recovery remains retained.
error.storage: The journal could not be read or written.
error.run: This run is not ready for local integration.
error.checkMissing: Unverified: the pinned Check requires the runner or has no supported command tool. Merge approval is unavailable.
error.checkFailed: Fresh Check failed. The result remains unapproved.
error.containment: Local integration cannot prove ownership of child processes on this platform. No command was started.
error.storageOwnership: Local integration cannot bind recovery storage to owned objects on this platform. The checkout and retained recovery have not been changed.
error.processUncertain: Child processes or pipes have an uncertain outcome. Retained recovery has not been removed. Inspect the recorded operation before continuing.

local_integration.trail: Review local  →  Preserve / commit  →  Sync + Check  →  Merge  →  Restore    ·    {{current}}
local_integration.commitIntroBody: Creates a local commit on main. Unselected staged files and working-copy changes remain intact.
local_integration.preserveIntroBody: Save verified file contents and original staged layout. Include only explicitly selected untracked files.
local_integration.ignored: Ignored files are excluded. A colliding ignored path blocks delivery; it is never silently deleted.
local_integration.ignoredNarrow: Ignored excluded; collision pauses delivery without discarding content.
local_integration.remainingBody: {{paths}} are excluded. Delivery stays paused until they are handled.
local_integration.remainingNone: No other local change remains after this commit.
local_integration.noDiscardBody: Ignored files are excluded. Collision blocks delivery. Unselected changes remain in place; cleaning starts only after durable snapshot verification.
local_integration.unreadableDiff: This diff cannot be shown. The checkout is unchanged.

prepareBody.one: 1 reviewed snapshot selected. Unselected changes keep delivery paused.
prepareBody.other: {{count}} reviewed snapshots selected. Unselected changes keep delivery paused.

local_integration.prepareNote: Commit and preservation require your reviewed file selection. No blanket foreign commit.
local_integration.prepareNarrowNote: Commit or preservation review precedes any mutation.
local_integration.commitAgree: I reviewed these exact snapshots and the commit message.
local_integration.commitNote: A new local commit changes main. Sync and Check again; never reuse the previous green Check.
local_integration.preserveAgree: I reviewed selected files and staged placement.
local_integration.restoreAfterMerge: Restore after merge; pause on conflicts.
local_integration.preserveNote: If snapshot verification fails, nothing is cleaned. A partial cleaning failure retains the verified recovery record.
local_integration.queueBody: One active checkout mutation. Waiting for merge approval does not hold the queue; restore conflicts retain a checkout reservation.
local_integration.dirty: Delivery paused: main has local changes
local_integration.dirtyBody: Review each snapshot. Commit selected changes or save a named temporary preservation.
local_integration.dirtyNarrowBody: Review exact staged and working-copy snapshots.
